link_source_contract.result: Both new tests passed; all eleven openobsidian-doc tests passed on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.
behavior: Extracts wiki links, Markdown links and embeds with raw source and destination byte spans.
Retains wiki aliases and heading/block subpaths without normalizing source bytes.
Uses UTF-8 byte offsets, including sources with a BOM and non-ASCII text.
Computes Markdown destination offsets from the parsed destination boundary, including when the visible label equals the target.
Does not resolve targets or rewrite source.
link_source_contract.compatibility_note: The legacy JavaScript helper used raw.indexOf(target), which can point at visible text when it equals a Markdown target. The Rust source span identifies the destination directly to keep future rename edits confined to the target.

limitations: This scanner does not yet exclude fenced code or inline code and is not used for resolution or edits in this slice.
Path resolution, heading/block uniqueness, unresolved/ambiguous outcomes and rename/move planning remain unimplemented in Rust.
Plugin reports are feasibility-only; broad legacy compatibility remains Pending.
finding: R2.4 passed exact-SHA GitHub Actions on Linux, macOS and Windows. All eleven document tests, formatting, Clippy, crate layering, native builds and unchanged-plugin feasibility probes passed; all five companion workflows passed.
scope: This milestone adds a source-ranged representation for supported wiki, Markdown and embed references. C03 remains pending until code-context handling, resolution, ambiguity reporting and safe reference updates are ported and verified. No local executable validation was run.
